title: Missed-Delivery Credit on a Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual Switch (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The missed-delivery credit of a switch into Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual under Delivery & Pickup Services depends on the failed delivery attempts on the plan in the 3 months up to the switch date. The credit is taken off the switch charge.

| Failed delivery attempts on the plan in the 3 months up to the switch date | Missed-delivery credit |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | $2.00 |
| 1 | $1.00 |
| none | nothing |

Every failed attempt recorded on the plan counts, whatever its reason and whether the order was later delivered, redelivered or returned to the store.

## Hypothetical histories

- One attempt failed for building access 5 weeks before the switch: $1.00.
- One attempt failed for weather 2 months before the switch and another for no one available to sign last week: $2.00.
- Three attempts failed, all 4 months before the switch: nothing.
